Ptilopsis:ThreadNetworkPower.NAME: Thread Network
DESCRIPTIONS: . Start-of-turn effects activate at the start of your turn; functions activate at the end. Triggering keeps the Thread; destructing frees its slot.

Ptilopsis:EnkephalinPower.NAME: Enkephalin
DESCRIPTIONS: card(s) you play manually, mount their function into a Mutable Thread and draw 1 card. On the turn you gain this Power, counting starts with your next manually played card.
